{{Quote|In contrast with a lot of planetary leaders, she put out word immediately that refugees were welcome to settle here. Kuratooine was outside the control of the New Republic, the Empire, and any other planetary alliance, so Dame Kura could get away with imposing some indentured-servitude restrictions on the new settlers&hellip;but she was smart, too, giving every settler a fair buyout price after three years of indenture|Voort saBinring on Dame Kura|<ref name="Mercy Kill" />}}
'''Dame Kura'''  was the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] [[Death/Legends|claimed]] the lives of most members of the Kura family, leaving her as its sole surviving member, she welcomed [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] to settle on Kuratooine, requiring them to serve three [[Standard year|years]] of indentured labor before allowing them to buy out their contracts at a fair price. Kura then loaned many of the settlers the funds to purchase land, fostering a population of hardworking landowners with long term ties to the planetary government.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

Dame also granted the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|Armed Forces]] century-long leases on large tracts of land for only one [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]], with the provision that she or her heirs would retain any immovable improvements after the leases expired. The arrangement encouraged the Alliance to establish military facilities on Kuratooine, including [[Rimsaw Station]], while also strengthening the planet's strategic importance near the border of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
